scope: Documentation of unchanged generated source; host producer/apply approval code not implemented by auditor.

fresh_snapshot.schema: outseop-r4.card-offers.v1 same exact key/row schema as stage v1
constraints: Different original/fresh SHA IDs; both exact bytes hash match path.
Same original card_sha256 and replace_text; both observed_at<=now<valid_until<=observed_at+180.
fresh.observed_at*1e9 >= stagefile.st_mtime_ns; complete real source reread after that whole-second boundary, not invented future timestamp.
Every selected row field equals original row (canonical JSON); available, grade ABC, positive integer price, valid fee and unexpired quote/offer.
Preserve still-source-backed original quote validity or restage; recomputing valid_until alone causes selected_offer_terms_changed.

authority.head: exact prior committed event SHA or null

apply_details_exact.replacement_sha256: SHA256 exact newly substituted description substring UTF8

authority.policy_constraints: Each nonblank clause exactly once in old and new descriptions, outside old replacement block. Anchors in skills alone do not satisfy.
authority.rollback_record_id: current active apply event SHA; authorized original backup restore; current hash must match

ownership_API.lock: card_publication/lock permanent regular file, shared same inode POSIX flock for every writer and guard
ownership_API.legacy_fence: Mandatory before authority installation; existing legacy publisher locks card.json inode, not this lock. Atomic replacement makes those different ownership protocols.
guard_checks: Acquire same lock; busy means wait.
Validate SHA filename against event bytes, shop/schema, committed head and exact current card SHA.
Pending publication, expired offer_until or conflicting/partial state means wait/conflict.
Do not fall back to old unguarded legacy writer on missing/expired/conflict state.
Active block start/end/text must match prior apply; rollback can restore previous_active.
Local apply success does not prove remote serving path shows same bytes; host must verify.

remaining_host_review: Protected trusted snapshot producer with authenticated current source; caller source strings and bool approvals are not authority.
No private unit cost, wallet, customer rights, token or raw financial rows in public card/context.
Review actual staged block meaning and pinned generation provenance before authority; apply alone does not validate product prose SKU/price/refund truth.
Before original baseline rollback, host must review restored offers; no previous_active offer_until exists for initial legacy baseline.
initial_live_blockers: Stage v1 prepends new block instead of preserving a nonempty old prefix; apply refuses text_outside_offer_block_changed.
Existing real card description has no mileage/wait/refund policy words and policies live in skills; apply requires original description anchors, rejecting protected_policy_overlap_or_change.
